crossings.description: black SUV in southbound left lane

notes: Only one southbound top-to-bottom crossing of packing_entry observed. White car was already south of the line at 0.0s so its crossing was before video. Blue car, motorcycle and later silver car turned left off the approach and never reached the line. All other vehicles after ~3s were northbound bottom-to-top and did not cross the southbound stop-line segment. The black SUV moved continuously through the inspection zone without stopping.
